events.text: Ammo. I don't have a gun yet, but ammo.

I can see my reflection in the marble. Wow.

I guess that counts as yellow.

A waystone! I can see the waystone!
I did it! All by myself!

profile.intro: 100% completion on everything, including games she hated. If it sparkles, she wants it before she leaves.
